name: Incarnation

VINIT.justification: The unmanifest Word existing before the creation of time and space.

TANCH.justification: The final restoration of all things within the divine life.

AFWD.justification: The self-emptying movement of the divine toward the finite.

AREV.justification: The ascending movement of the human toward the divine.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of grace through historical events and signs.

IMSCRIB.justification: The identity of essence between the Father and the Son.

FSPLIT.justification: The single person of the Word branching into distinct divine and human natures.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the two natures into the single person of Christ.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative human consent that enables the union.

EVALF.justification: The rejection of the union or the separation of the natures.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous attribution of both divine and human properties to the one person.

IFIX.justification: The permanent and irreversible fixation of matter into the divine life.

phase_3.void_description: The silence of the Godhead before the utterance of the Word.
phase_3.true_description: The affirmation of the material world as a vehicle for divinity.
phase_3.false_description: The dualistic denial of the goodness of matter or the reality of the flesh.
phase_3.both_description: The mystery of the God-Man existing as fully infinite and fully finite.

steps.domain_action: The Logos exists in the eternal silence of the Father.
The Logos recognizes its own consubstantiality with the source.
The Logos initiates the descent toward the created order.
The single person enters the state of having two distinct natures.
The human will provides the affirmative vessel for the descent.
The properties of divinity and humanity interpenetrate without confusion.
The human nature begins its ascent through the life of the Logos.
The possibility of rejection and the reality of suffering are encountered.
The two natures are held in the indivisible unity of the one person.
The life of the Incarnate Word chains into the history of the world.
The union of God and man is permanently sealed in the glorified body.
The entire system is enclosed in the finality of the divine purpose.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Holy Spirit acting as the agent of the overshadowing.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Perichoresis or the mutual indwelling of the divine persons.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Holy Tradition and the liturgical anamnesis.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Kairos or the fullness of time.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Sacred Scriptures and the Ecumenical Dogmas.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The kenotic sacrifice of the divine self-limitation.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: The separation of the infinite Creator and the finite creature.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The eternal union of the Creator and the creature in a single person.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The descent of the divine is perfectly balanced by the exaltation of the human.
